reddit.title: Introducing the New Materials System in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to how resources are displayed in Provincia! No longer will you see a single cost chip for building tiles. Instead, each tile will now feature a detailed **Materials** sheet that allows you to view stored vs required resources, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change makes it much easier to plan your builds. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Update: Enhanced Materials Display
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major improvement in how you manage resources in Provincia! Our new **Materials** system provides a clear view of what you have versus what you need for each building tile. This change aims to simplify your building process and enhance your gameplay experience. Discover more about this update here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
